title: quickstart-fieldplay-notes-sep-07-2026
content:
Meeting: Quickstart Field Play — notes and action items
Date: 2026-09-07
Facilitator: Hannah Lee
Attendees: Hannah, Miguel, Priya, Daniel, Camille (joined 10:15), Aaron (observing)
Absentees: none noted

Purpose: capture qualitative feedback from the internal field play of the new Quickstart v2 flow, triage discovered friction, and decide next rolling patches for SDKs/samples/docs. This session focused on the JS and Python quickstarts, the minimal sample app, and onboarding telemetry signals.

1) Quick summary / headline findings
- First-time-run experience is materially better vs. v1: reduced config surface and clearer error text reported by 8/10 internal testers.
- Two pain areas repeatedly surfaced: (a) credential initialization error messaging (ambiguous for customized API endpoints), (b) sample app hot-reload failing on Windows dev machines.
- Telemetry currently shows ~40% of runs failing before success (mostly due to missing env var). We need a lightweight guard and an explicit `rwi init` prompt.

2) Field observations (raw)
- Miguel: JS quickstart works end-to-end on Mac, but windows devs hit node-gyp native deps in the embedding sample. Workaround: use prebuilt wheel in CI, but dev experience suffers.
- Priya: docs table of expected env vars (API_KEY, REGION) was missing the optional PRIVATE_ENDPOINT example. Led to 3 devs misconfiguring the URL and getting 404s.
- Daniel: sample-app (Next.js) hot-reload breaks after first request — reproducible with fast-refresh + nested dynamic imports. Looks like our wrapper HMR proxy conflicts with the local dev server.
- Camille: onboarding prompt text was unclear about default model selection; users assumed hosted default would map to their dedicated pool.

3) Prioritized bug/ticket list (consensus)
- High: improve runtime credential validation and add `rwi init` interactive flow that checks endpoint reachability (owner: Priya, ticket DEVEXP-78, target: 2026-09-14).
- High: patch sample-app HMR proxy — disable proxy for local dev when NODE_ENV=development (owner: Daniel, linked PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-examples/pulls/312, target: 2026-09-10).
- Medium: publish prebuilt Windows-compatible artifacts for node native deps in JS embedding sample; document workaround (owner: Miguel, follow-up GH issue).
- Medium: update docs with PRIVATE_ENDPOINT examples + short troubleshooting snippet for 404s (owner: Hannah, doc PR draft in Confluence page).
- Low: add explicit note about dedicated vs hosted model selection and recommended defaults for quickstarts (owner: Camille).

4) SDK changes considered (scope + tradeoffs)
- Add a thin client-side validation on quickstart templates that runs before the first API call to catch malformed endpoints. Tradeoff: small startup overhead but avoids many failed runs recorded in telemetry. Team agreed acceptable.
- Option: auto-fallback to hosted endpoint when private endpoint fails — rejected for v2 (too risky for security/consent expectations). Park for v3.

5) Telemetry & metrics actionables
- Current signal: quickstart-run (start, error_code, step, os, sdk_lang). Missing: human-readable error_text and host_reachability boolean.
- Action: add host_reachability check to telemetry and emit a specific error_code for env-var-missing vs endpoint-unreachable (owner: Miguel, Linear LD-419, due 2026-09-11).
- Action: add a short onboarding funnel dashboard (success rate, time-to-first-success, common error codes) to Console -> DevExp section (owner: Priya, coordinate with observability team).

6) Docs & samples edits (what to change now)
- Quickstart README: add Windows troubleshooting block, known issues for HMR, and `rwi init` example output.
- Minimal sample: reduce sample complexity: remove nested dynamic import in the minimal flow, keep it in advanced example only. (owner: Daniel)
- Snippets: add a two-line snippet for `export RW_API_KEY=...` and a Powershell equiv; put snippet above the first code block so users don’t miss it.

7) UX / copy decisions (quick)
- Change "Default model" label to "Initial model (changeable)" — reduces confusion about pinned deployments. Priya to update wording in the quickstart copy.
- Error toast copy: replace generic "request failed" with "Could not reach API endpoint — check PRIVATE_ENDPOINT and network access" for the specific unreachable case.

8) Risks & open questions
- If we add prebuilt binaries for Windows, will CI artifact storage costs increase materially? (Engineering infra to advise).
- Could the HMR proxy change break legacy advanced samples? We need an integration test matrix for major dev environments.
- How will these quickstart changes affect our onboarding metrics (DAU->engagement)? Set a baseline before wide rollout.

9) Action items (owner — due)
- Priya: implement `rwi init` interactive check + doc example (DEVEXP-78) — due 2026-09-14.
- Daniel: open hotfix PR to disable proxy for NODE_ENV=development and add test (PR 312) — due 2026-09-10.
- Miguel: publish Windows artifact plan + GH issue with steps for producing prebuilt artifacts — due 2026-09-13.
- Hannah: update Confluence quickstart page with PRIVATE_ENDPOINT examples and Powershell snippets — due 2026-09-09.
- Camille: write short copy blurbs for model selection and toast messages — due 2026-09-10.
- Priya + Observability (liaison: Aaron): draft onboarding funnel dashboard spec — due 2026-09-16.

10) Parking lot / follow-ups
- Consider an automated local dev checklist that runs once per repo clone (low priority).
- Explore a short "compatibility matrix" doc for OS / node / python versions for quickstarts (assign later).

11) Next sync
- Quick follow-up async: update PRs + doc edits by 2026-09-09; 15-minute sync Fri 2026-09-10 09:30 PT to verify progress (calendar invite).

Notes to self: keep internal quickstart branch stable for user research cohort next month; avoid large refactors between now and 2026-09-20.

End of notes.
